check_box.name: ao_default
check_box.label: Varsayılan
check_box.tool_tip: Make this animation set the default set that plays when you log in. If no animation set is the default, use the animation set from last session.

check_box.name: ao_sit_override
check_box.label: Override Sits
check_box.tool_tip: Check this if you want sit animation overrides.

check_box.name: ao_smart
check_box.label: Be smart
check_box.tool_tip: Smart mode tries to determine if the sit override would clash with the object's own animation and disables the overrider temporarily.

check_box.name: ao_disable_stands_in_mouselook
check_box.label: Disable Stands in Mouselook
check_box.tool_tip: If you need to preserve your custom stand animation in mouselook, check this box.

button.name: ao_move_up
button.tool_tip: Move the selected animation or animation group up in the list.

button.name: ao_move_down
button.tool_tip: Move the selected animation or animation group down in the list.

button.name: ao_trash
button.tool_tip: Remove the selected animation from the list.

combo_box.name: ao_track_selection_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Select which animation track of this state to show. The main list plays as usual, additional tracks play and cycle independently alongside it, for example a tail wag next to all walking animations.

button.name: ao_track_add
button.tool_tip: Add a new independent animation track to this state.

check_box.name: ao_cycle
check_box.label: Cycle
check_box.tool_tip: Play a different animation from the list every time the animation state is called.

check_box.name: ao_randomize
check_box.label: Randomize order
check_box.tool_tip: Randomize order of animations in cycle mode.

spinner.name: ao_cycle_time
spinner.tool_tip: Time before switching to the next animation in the list. Set this to 0 to disable automatic animation cycling.

button.name: ao_previous
button.tool_tip: Switch to previous animation of the current state.

button.name: ao_next
button.tool_tip: Switch to next animation of the current state.

button.name: ao_previous_small
button.tool_tip: Switch to previous animation of the current state.

button.name: ao_next_small
button.tool_tip: Switch to next animation of the current state.

check_box.name: ao_sit_override_small
check_box.label: Sits
check_box.tool_tip: Check this if you want sit animation overrides.
